description: Lists the statutory periods of the SARFAESI Act, 2002 — Section 13(2) (demand notice — time to discharge liability); Section 13(3A) (creditor’s reply to the borrower’s representation); Section 14 (second proviso) (district magistrate / cmm to pass a possession order); Section 17(1) (securitisation application to the drt); Section 17(5) (drt to dispose of the securitisation application); Section 18(1) (appeal to the drat) — with the enacted wording, who each period binds and what follows when it ends. Optionally computes the end date from a start date. Use for SARFAESI deadline and limitation questions.

from_date.description: Date the period runs from, as YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY, to compute the date it ends

period.description: Which period: "s13-2" = Section 13(2); "s13-3a" = Section 13(3A); "s14" = Section 14 (second proviso); "s17-1" = Section 17(1); "s17-5" = Section 17(5); "s18-1" = Section 18(1); or "all" (default)

name: sarfaesi_timeline
title: SARFAESI statutory periods
